summary: Meta AI announced the release of Muse Spark 1.3, a point update to its Spark model line focused on agentic tasks, coding, and longer-horizon instruction following.

practices.reason: A named, shipped model update claims better agentic, coding and instruction-following performance, but no benchmark figures are given to confirm the gain.
practices.quote: It’s designed to support longer-horizon work, excel in agentic tasks, and follow complex instructions more reliably than previous models.
